notes.title: Update bHaptics Player 2.5.2.56
notes.content:
# bHaptics Player 2.5.2 (11th, Dec 2024)
* New Features
   - On-Device AtH Profile
      - Added the ability to store profiles on devices for Wired Audio-to-Haptic functionality, enabling seamless and personalized haptic experiences
* Fixes
   - Device Image Display
      - Enhanced visibility and clarity of device images to improve user experience in device selection and management.
   - Bluetooth 4.0 Motor Vibration
      - Fixed motor vibration issues for Bluetooth 4.0, ensuring consistent and reliable haptic feedback.
   - Minor Bug Fixes
      - Addressed various minor bugs to improve stability and performance.

# bHaptics Player 2.5.1 (3rd, Dec 2024)
* Fixes
   - Enhanced Haptic Resolution
      - Fixed connection issues on certain devices and added an option to disable the Enhanced Haptic Resolution feature.

# bHaptics Player 2.5.0 (27th, Nov 2024)
* New Features
   - bHaptics Pro, Air, Sleeve Device Support
      - Added compatibility for bHaptics Pro, Air, and Sleeve devices, enhancing the haptic experience across supported hardware
* Updates
   - Audio-To-Haptic Improvements
      - Fine-tuned the audio-to-haptic conversion for a more immersive and precise feedback experience.
   - Minor UI Enhancements
      - Improved UI elements for better usability and aesthetics.
* Additions
   - Lab Function
      - Introduced a new experimental feature under the Lab section for early testing and feedback.
* Fixes
   - Login Bug Resolved
      - Fixed an issue causing login failures in certain scenarios.
   - Minor Bug Fixes
      - Addressed various minor bugs to improve stability and performance.

# bHaptics Player 2.4.0 (26th, Aug 2024)
* Updated: Audio-To-Haptic Improvement
* Updated: PS VR2 platform
* Fixed: Sdk method
* Fixed: Update Check
* Fixed: IsMinimizeToTray default value
* Fixed: minor bug
